# PROXY

> PROXY is a fast, customizable AI chat assistant for Windows, Mac, and the web. Replies are shaped by reusable “states”, named triggers with your instructions, so you do not rewrite the same system prompt every time.

- Site: https://getproxy.ca
- Web chat: https://getproxy.ca/app
- States gallery: https://getproxy.ca/states
- About: https://getproxy.ca/about
- Contact: https://getproxy.ca/contact
- Privacy: https://getproxy.ca/privacy
- Desktop downloads (latest): https://github.com/HSterben/Proxy/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/HSterben/Proxy
- Support email: sterben@sterben.dev

## What PROXY is

PROXY is productivity software: an AI assistant with streaming chat. A “state” is a named setup (trigger word + instructions + optional model settings). Typing the trigger first in a message applies that state’s instructions. Free accounts get a small lifetime chat allowance and three built-in states (Simplify, List, Critique). Pro unlocks higher monthly chat capacity and creating/publishing custom states.

## Pricing (USD)

- Free: $0, about 30 lifetime requests; states Simplify, List, Critique; Windows + Mac apps + PROXY Web
- Pro: $10 / month, monthly chat allowance; create and publish custom states; sync across web and desktop
- Yearly: $99 / year, same as Pro, billed annually
- Billing is managed at https://getproxy.ca/account/billing (not inside the desktop app)

## Platforms

- Windows and Mac desktop apps (bubble / shortcuts), distributed via GitHub Releases
- PROXY Web chat in the browser at getproxy.ca
- Same PROXY account (WorkOS AuthKit) on all clients
